root_cause: The model-missing classifier repeatedly followed the root exception cause/context instead of the current node, so deeper wrappers lost the offline-cache diagnosis. Unmapped ASR ValueError wrappers bypassed that classifier entirely.
changes: Follow the current exception cause or context, preferring an explicit cause even when its truth value is false
Track visited identities so cycles do not repeat nodes; retain the existing six-total-node inspection limit
Keep existing missing-class and message recognizers unchanged
Classify unmapped ASR ValueError wrappers while preserving all mapped business errors, missing-component priority and non-ASR ValueError behavior
Report media_asr_model_missing with the existing offline-cache guidance; do not download models or replay failed work
